We visited My Son Sanctuary, one of Vietnam’s most fascinating UNESCO World Heritage Sites, on a tour from Da Nang. In this video, we will show you what it’s really like, share tips for visiting, and answer the big question, is it worth it?

📍 Location: My Son Sanctuary, Vietnam
🚐 Departure: Da Nang

⏱️⏱️ VIDEO CHAPTERS ⏱️⏱️

00:00 Intro
00:43 Ways To Get There
01:02 Using Klook To Book
01:29 Tip: Go Early In The Morning
01:41 The Drive To My Son
01:53 Getting Tickets & Audio Guide
02:20 Walk To The Shuttle
02:45 Getting To The Trailhead
03:18 Cham Cultural Performance
03:42 Visiting The Temple Complex
06:33 Is It Worth Visiting
07:06 Outro

If you’re planning a Vietnam trip, this ancient temple complex is a must-see.

#VietnamTravel #MySonSanctuary #DaNang #VietnamVlog

comments.text: We almost didn’t visit this place. Have you ever skipped something on a trip that you later regretted?

comments.author: @388_days
comments.text: Great video. We loved our visit to My Son well. Watching your videos is bringing back some great memories of Vietnam.

comments.author: @JimAndAmy
comments.text: Thank you 😊. My Son was one of those tours that surprised us. We had little idea about it before we went, and we were in awe of the peaceful beauty of the site and the history of it, as well as the history of the Champ Kingdom. We are glad that we could share this with others.
